title: Hatsune Miku — Watchful Seniors〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They've taken on quite a challenge...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're good through like the third song, but they start looking visibly tired from the fourth onwards...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ichika seems to be out of breath too...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're practicing for the real thing by playing songs back to back, which is likely going to take its toll both physically and mentally.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, next song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well, thanks for today.
We'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll see you all later.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They looked exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, they did...
Playing this much back to back must've been harder on them than we realized.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree.
Their performance began to unravel during the second half...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It seems that they're at a critical juncture...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But...!
Can't we just sub in for them partway or something?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's no way we could do that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Unfortunately...
All we can do is watch over them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want the girls to keep trying their best...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since this is their big chance to achieve their dream of going pro together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm worried about them practicing so hard... If something were to happen to any of them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika in particular, since she sang with everything she had throughout their practice... She could lose her voice at any given time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only that, they have to do a whole list of other things in preparation for their solo show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why I'm really worried about them having to work so hard...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I can't possibly tell them not to do that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku-P...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel, Miku.
I'm just as worried as you are.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Saki's prone to getting sick and Honami has to physically do more work by virtue of being the drummer...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shiho also has a strong sense of responsibility and wants to become a professional musician above all else, so she's not going to stop here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just seeing them... I agree with you, Rin. I wish there were some way we could swap places with them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm also confident that they'll figure out a way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They've overcome so much already...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When they decided to go pro together, and when they had their intense practice sessions here so they could show that their music means something...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They made it this far because they didn't run away from themselves, no?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...!
I'm super worried... But the girls should be able to...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'm sure they'll find a way to fly past this hurdle!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, let's maintain our faith and keep supporting them as much as we can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Worrying won't actually help solve anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, to make sure that their solo show succeeds, let's keep watching over them and be ready to support the girls at a moment's notice!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes!
